# Open choices: dependency-upgrade

`aidd-team:dependency-upgrade` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scorecard-floor` | Which OpenSSF Scorecard score triggers a human check on a dependency upgrade? | The team states its own Scorecard floor in the repository policy. | team-defined Scorecard floor, flag any score drop |
